candidates.change_summary: Replace the returned value _owner with msg.sender.
Replace the returned value _owner with the zero address.
Replace the ownership transfer target so ownership is always renounced instead of assigned to newOwner.
Invert the require check so that only transfers to the zero address succeed.
Delete the zero-address check so transferring ownership to address(0) is allowed.
Delete the ownership transfer call so the owner never changes and no OwnershipTransferred event is emitted.
Move the transfer above the require so a transfer to the zero address executes (and reverts after) before the check.
Remove the ownership check so any caller can transfer ownership.
Invert the ownership check so only non-owners can call guarded functions.
Insert a redundant transfer to the current owner before the body, emitting an extra OwnershipTransferred event on every guarded call.
